name: Raaj Medisafe India Limited
about: Raaj Medisafe India Limited manufactures and sells disposable hygiene products, HDPE containers, PP closures and plastic liners for packaging of goods, and aluminum crown caps in India. The company operates through two segments, Plastic and Hygiene. It offers caps and plugs, plastic liners, and aluminum caps. The company also offers sanitary napkins, maternity pads, baby diapers and panty liners. In addition, it offers aluminium and VCI bags, plastic rolls, food grade poly bags and sheet, and DMF certified poly bags and sheets. The company was formerly known as Manoj Surgical Industries Limited. Raaj Medisafe India Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Ujjain, India.
